title: Extraction of Total Nucleic Acid from Environmental Samples
author: Dilip Abraham
materials: QIAamp Fast DNA stool Mini Kit
QIAamp Fast DNA stool Mini Kit Qiagen Catalog ##51604 Kit used

steps.title: Prepare bead tubes with membrane strips
steps.instruction: Add cut membrane filter strips to 2 mL screw‑cap micro tubes that already contain ~370 mg (one 2 mL Eppendorf capful) of acid‑washed glass beads for each Moore swab sample.

steps.title: Add extraction blank tube
steps.instruction: Include one extra tube that contains only beads and InhibitEX buffer to serve as an extraction blank.

steps.title: Bead‑beat samples
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a bead beater and shake at maximum speed for 00:02:00 (2 minutes).

steps.title: Heat incubation at 95 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspensions for 00:05:00 (5 minutes) at 95 °C.

steps.title: Vortex briefly
steps.instruction: Vortex the tubes for 00:00:15 (15 seconds).

steps.title: Add Proteinase K to new tube
steps.instruction: Pipette 25 µL Proteinase K into a new 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to Proteinase K tube
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 600 µL of supernatant from the bead‑beaten tubes into the tube containing the 25 µL Proteinase K.

steps.title: Add Buffer AL and mix
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Buffer AL to the mixture (do not add Proteinase K directly to Buffer AL). Vortex for 00:00:15 (15 seconds) to obtain a homogeneous solution.

steps.title: Incubate at 70 °C then brief centrifuge
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 70 °C for 00:10:00 (10 minutes). After incubation, centrifuge briefly to remove drops from the inside of the tube lid.

steps.title: Add ethanol to lysate and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL ethanol (96–100 %) to the lysate, vortex to mix, and centrifuge briefly to remove drops from the tube lid.

steps.title: Load lysate onto QIAamp spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer 600 µL of the lysate onto a QIAamp spin column placed in a new 2 mL collection tube (do not moisten the rim). Centrifuge at full speed to pass the lysate through. Repeat this loading step twice more (total ~1800 µL) until all lysate has passed through the column.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL lysate, centrifuge at full speed.
Add second 600 µL lysate, centrifuge at full speed.
Add third 600 µL lysate, centrifuge at full speed.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, and centrifuge at full speed for 00:01:00 (1 minute).

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2, and centrifuge at full speed for 00:01:00 (1 minute).

steps.title: Final high‑speed spin to remove wash buffer
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 00:03:00 (3 minutes) to eliminate any possible Buffer AW2 carry‑over.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acid with Buffer ATE
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new 1.75 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 100 µL Buffer ATE directly onto the membrane, and centrifuge at full speed for 00:01:00 (1 minute) to elute the total nucleic acid (TNA).

steps.title: Aliquot eluate and store at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL of the extracted TNA into a 1.75 mL screw‑cap tube and store at –80 °C for long‑term storage; store the remaining 50 µL eluate at –80 °C for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Nanotrap: add controls and InhibitEX buffer
steps.instruction: Add both extraction controls to the Nanotrap sample tube, then add 700 µL InhibitEX buffer.

steps.title: Nanotrap: pellet particles at high speed
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at full speed (≈20,000 g) for 00:01:00 (1 minute) to pellet the particles.

steps.title: Nanotrap: sequential spin‑column washes
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube and perform three successive washes:

substeps.instruction: Add appropriate wash buffer, centrifuge at full speed for 00:01:00 (1 minute) and discard flow‑through and collection tube.
Repeat the above wash (second wash) for 00:01:00 (1 minute) and discard flow‑through.
Perform a final wash, centrifuge at full speed for 00:03:00 (3 minutes) and discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Nanotrap: room‑temperature incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the column at room temperature for 1–3 minutes.

steps.title: Nanotrap: elute TNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at full speed for 00:01:00 (1 minute) to elute the total nucleic acid from the column.

steps.title: Other wastewater: resuspend pellet and add to bead tube
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL sterile PBS, then add 1 mL of this suspension to a 2 mL screw‑cap micro tube that contains ~370 mg (one 2 mL Eppendorf capful) of acid‑washed glass beads.

steps.title: Other wastewater: add controls and InhibitEX buffer
steps.instruction: Add both extraction controls to the tube and then add 700 µL InhibitEX buffer.
